briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as inflation moderates and the job market stays resilient.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.56 percent for Sep 2026 sits just above the Fed's target, releasing pressure.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 keeps households earning and spending steady.

briefing.whats_new: Today: US Dollar index firmer, from 121.32 to 121.67.
